newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says to up base stations production.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says to up base stations production.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Thursday it would expand production of base stations at Oulu in north-western Finland.

"Nokia Telecommunications will expand its base station production in Oulu ... because of the increase in market demand for base stations," it said, but gave no details of by how much output would increase.
"The new manufacturing site will employ some 300 people," Nokia said. The new facility, to be located near its existing Oulu base stations factory, would come on stream in spring 1997.
Nokia also makes base stations in the United Kingdom, the United States, Australia and China.
